title: ChatGPT: strong mentions but weak owned citations
finding: Mention Rate is 72.7%; Citation Rate is 27.0%.
recommended_action: Review the pages and source types that this platform tends to cite; create clearer evidence and comparison assets for the affected prompt clusters.

title: Repeated runs show measurable answer volatility
finding: 164 of 300 prompt-platform pairs are highly volatile and 67 are medium volatility.
recommended_action: Keep at least three repeated runs in the demo and show stability/volatility beside visibility metrics; avoid interpreting single responses as stable rankings.

title: Gemini: strong mentions but weak owned citations
finding: Mention Rate is 63.3%; Citation Rate is 18.0%.
recommended_action: Review the pages and source types that this platform tends to cite; create clearer evidence and comparison assets for the affected prompt clusters.

title: Brand visibility is not converting into owned-domain citations
finding: NORTHWEAR is mentioned in 72.2% of measurements but its own website is cited in only 29.3%.
evidence: Gap: 42.9% between Mention Rate and Citation Rate.
recommended_action: Prioritize citation-ready category, product-comparison and editorial pages with clear facts, structured product details and quotable evidence.

title: A high-priority buyer prompt has a major visibility gap
finding: 'Welcher Hoodie hält warm, ohne extrem schwer zu sein?' has an opportunity score of 89.8/100 and a Visibility Score of 17.8%.
recommended_action: Create or improve a landing page / comparison asset that answers this exact buyer need, then measure the same prompt across all engines and runs.

title: Gemini is the largest platform visibility gap
finding: NORTHWEAR scores 44.3% on Gemini versus 58.7% on Perplexity.
recommended_action: Audit the source mix and weak prompt categories specifically for Gemini; do not optimize from the blended score alone.

title: The owned domain has room to become a more frequent AI source
finding: northwear.de appears in 21.0% of all synthetic citation-domain occurrences.
recommended_action: Create more citation-ready product, comparison and guide pages; strengthen factual product data and internal linking.

title: Perplexity: strong mentions but weak owned citations
finding: Mention Rate is 80.7%; Citation Rate is 43.0%.
recommended_action: Review the pages and source types that this platform tends to cite; create clearer evidence and comparison assets for the affected prompt clusters.

title: Problem prompts are the weakest demand cluster
finding: Problem has a Visibility Score of 47.7%, compared with 55.7% for Purchase Intent.
recommended_action: Build content and product evidence directly around the weak buyer questions in this cluster, then re-run the same prompts.

title: Mentions do not always become recommendations
finding: NORTHWEAR's Mention Rate is 72.2%, while Recommendation Rate is 60.2%.
recommended_action: Strengthen differentiators that AI systems can use in recommendations: price bands, materials, use cases, fit, shipping and returns.

title: youtube.com is a high-value third-party source opportunity
finding: youtube.com accounts for 15.7% of source occurrences, but NORTHWEAR recommendation association is 59.3%.
recommended_action: Increase NORTHWEAR presence on this source type through useful comparisons, product evidence, reviews or editorial coverage.

title: Purchase-intent visibility is above the overall benchmark
finding: Purchase Intent scores 55.7%, above the overall 51.7%.
evidence: This is strategically valuable because the prompt cluster is closer to a transaction.
recommended_action: Protect purchase-intent coverage and connect these prompts to landing pages and future AI-referral tracking.

title: Perplexity is currently NORTHWEAR's strongest AI platform
finding: The synthetic benchmark shows the highest Visibility Score on Perplexity at 58.7%.
evidence: Use this as a pattern library: inspect which prompts and source types coincide with stronger results, then test whether those patterns transfer to weaker platforms.
recommended_action: Preserve winning content/source patterns while continuing repeated measurement.
